test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A and B, working together, take 15 days to complete a piece of work. If A alone can do this work in 18 days, then how long would B take to complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together complete the work in 15 days.

A alone completes the work in 18 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work rate of A = 1/Time taken by A

Work rate of B = 1/Time taken by B

Combined work rate of A and B = Work rate of A + Work rate of B

**Calculation:**

Work rate of A = 1/18

Work rate of A and B together = 1/15

Let the time taken by B alone to complete the work be B days.

Work rate of B = 1/B

Combined work rate of A and B:

1/18 + 1/B = 1/15

Solving for B:

⇒ 1/18 + 1/B = 1/15

⇒ 1/B = 1/15 - 1/18

⇒ 1/B = (18 - 15) / (15 × 18)

⇒ 1/B = 3 / 270

⇒ 1/B = 1 / 90

⇒ B = 90

**B alone would take 90 days to complete the same work.**
